project.title: Hybrid Workplace Wellbeing & Client Visit Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a structured wellbeing and client-visit experience program for hybrid offices to improve employee health and client satisfaction.
deliverables: Client visit playbook and on-site visit checklist
Quarterly wellbeing and client feedback survey templates
Centralised schedule for client visits and wellbeing activities
Training session for assistants and account managers on new processes
constraints: Program must be launch-ready within 21 days
No additional headcount; use existing staff and tools
Comply with workplace health and safety regulations
Client visits must not disrupt critical business operations
All materials must be available in at least two languages

risks.risk: Low engagement from employees and clients with the new program.
risks.mitigation: Involve representatives in design, run a pilot, and adjust based on early feedback.

risks.risk: Scheduling conflicts between client visits and wellbeing activities.
risks.mitigation: Create a shared calendar with clear priorities and approval rules.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with health and safety or privacy regulations.
risks.mitigation: Have HR and legal review guidelines and survey templates before launch.

risks.risk: Overload of management assistants with coordination tasks.
risks.mitigation: Standardise templates, automate reminders, and limit number of parallel activities.

themes.why_relevant: Need clear routines that work for both on-site and remote days.
Occupational therapist leads evidence-based activities and safeguards health.
Sales account manager must align visits with wellbeing-focused office experience.
Management assistants coordinate calendars, rooms, and communications.
Surveys and reports are needed to refine the program after launch.

backlog.task: Draft hybrid workplace wellbeing guidelines for on-site and remote days
definition_of_done: Guidelines cover physical, mental, and ergonomic aspects
Reviewed by HR and operations manager
Available in two languages
Uploaded to shared drive and linked in internal comms

backlog.task: Design standard client visit playbook aligned with wellbeing program
definition_of_done: Playbook covers pre-visit, on-site, and follow-up steps
Includes wellbeing-friendly office tour script
Validated by occupational therapist and operations manager
Shared with all account managers

backlog.task: Create on-site client visit checklist for reception and assistants
definition_of_done: Checklist includes room setup, safety, refreshments, and materials
Reviewed by sales account manager and occupational therapist
Printed template ready at reception and digital version stored centrally

backlog.task: Set up centralised calendar for client visits and wellbeing activities
definition_of_done: Shared calendar created in existing office system
Access rights defined for all relevant roles
Color-coding and naming conventions documented
Test event created and confirmed by all stakeholders

backlog.task: Prepare quarterly wellbeing and client satisfaction survey templates
definition_of_done: Two survey templates created: employees and clients
Questions reviewed by HR for compliance and clarity
Surveys tested internally with at least 5 respondents
Survey links documented in program overview

backlog.task: Draft internal communication plan for program launch
definition_of_done: Launch email draft prepared in two languages
Short FAQ created for employees and client-facing staff
Communication timeline agreed with HR and sales account manager
Messages scheduled or assigned in office system

backlog.task: Align client segmentation and visit priorities with new program
definition_of_done: Client segments defined with visit frequency guidelines
Priority rules documented and shared with assistants
At least 10 key accounts mapped to visit slots
Playbook updated with segmentation section

backlog.task: Create training session agenda for assistants and account managers
definition_of_done: Agenda covers guidelines, playbook, calendar, and surveys
Timeboxed to max 60 minutes with Q&A
Speakers confirmed: occupational therapist and sales account manager
Session date booked in shared calendar

backlog.task: Define simple reporting template for monthly program status
definition_of_done: Template includes key activities, attendance, and issues
Reviewed by occupational therapist and sales account manager
Stored in shared folder with clear naming convention
Example report filled for pilot month

backlog.task: Pilot the program with one office and a small client group
definition_of_done: At least 3 client visits and 2 wellbeing activities completed
Checklists used and stored for each event
Feedback collected via survey templates
Summary of pilot findings shared in channel

backlog.task: Review legal and compliance aspects of surveys and guidelines
definition_of_done: Documents sent to HR/legal for review
Feedback received and incorporated
Final versions marked as approved in shared drive
Approval status communicated in channel
Process describes how feedback is collected and prioritised
Roles and responsibilities clearly assigned
Review cadence (monthly/quarterly) defined
Process shared and acknowledged in channel

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success criteria, and initial backlog for the program.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the hybrid wellbeing and client visit program project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final scope and success metrics for the first 3 months of the program.
Agree on ownership of each backlog task T1–T4 and initial deadlines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the client visit playbook and on-site checklist details.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and key steps of the client visit playbook.
Lock the final version of the on-site client visit checklist for pilot use.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up calendar, communication plan, and training session logistics.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant posts proposal for calendar setup and launch comms.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose the final calendar structure and access rules for visits and activities.
Confirm training session date, duration, and agenda.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on survey templates, compliance checks, and reporting format.
threads_plan.trigger: Occupational therapist shares draft survey questions and improvement process.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve final survey templates for employees and clients.
Agree on monthly reporting template and review cadence.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run pilot debrief and decide adjustments before wider rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Sales account manager posts summary of pilot visits and wellbeing activities.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final scope and success metrics for the first 3 months of the program.
Lock the final version of the on-site client visit checklist for pilot use.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts yesterday/today/blockers in one thread.
Weekly planning message to review upcoming client visits and wellbeing activities.
Post-training recap thread capturing key questions and clarifications.
Monthly mini-retro after status report to agree 1–2 concrete improvements.
Pilot debrief ritual after each client visit during pilot, using a short checklist.
